Transport layer, provider adaptation batches, OAuth refresh, free providers, E2E coverage and curated registry.

phases.name: Security Hardening & Core Proxy Reliability Audit
phases.description: Resolve the 2026-08-12 deep-audit findings before public deployment. Full details: docs/SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-08-12.md.
tasks: 37A: secure-by-default bind/auth; redact all provider/API secrets from response DTOs; protect privileged management endpoints
37A: make login limiter race-safe and bounded; replace default password and migrate password hashing; initialize auth secret explicitly under the fixed application data directory
37B: unify single/combo/messages upstream execution; make translation, refresh, fallback classification, state persistence and usage behavior consistent
37C: implement event-correct SSE forwarding; distinguish EOF/error/cancel; split streaming timeouts; enforce request/response/multipart/header limits
37D: validate custom BaseURL and panel-url against SSRF/redirect policy; make panel extraction and sensitive config writes atomic and permission-safe
37E: add regression/E2E coverage, then run go fmt ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./..., go test -race ./... and vulnerability scanning
phases.notes: Static backend audit recorded 2026-08-12. No legacy compatibility is required because the project is pre-production. Dynamic Go verification remains mandatory before completion.

phases.name: WebUI Provider Workflow & Product Logic Rebuild
phases.description: Rebuild frontend contract/state and the Provider Catalog -> Connection workflow. Details: docs/FRONTEND_AUDIT_2026-08-12.md.
tasks: 38A: typed API contract, secret-free DTOs, domain stores, request cancellation and local mutation refresh
38B: split Connections from Provider Catalog and implement schema-driven three-step connection wizard
38C: rebuild connection workspace, model/routing Route Inspector and shared cancellable SSE tester
38D: consolidate design system components and complete keyboard/mobile/dark/light browser QA

release_gate: Phase 37 must be done before public deployment; Phase 38 must be done before declaring the management UI product-ready.

work_items.name: Secure Boundary and Credentials
work_items.summary: Implemented secure loopback-by-default bind, redacted provider secret DTOs, race-safe bounded login rate limiter, Argon2id password hashing with legacy migration, and unauthenticated remote management block.

work_items.name: Unified Upstream Executor
work_items.summary: Extracted unified upstream executor and candidate pipeline (PrepareUpstreamRequest, ExecuteAttempt). Unified error classification taxonomy to strictly prevent 400/422 deterministic errors from triggering fallback, while correctly failing over on 429/rate limits with backoff state updates.

work_items.name: Streaming and Resource Limits
work_items.summary: Implemented event-correct SSEReader & FormatSSEEvent handling multiline data, comments, id and events without misinterpreting stream boundaries. Added RequestSizeLimiter middleware enforcing 10MB JSON and 50MB multipart limits.

work_items.name: Active Network and File Safety
work_items.summary: Implemented SSRF policy and validation via ValidateUpstreamURL and SafeHTTPClient blocking loopback, link-local, private IP and cloud metadata ranges with hop-by-hop redirect verification.

work_items.name: Database V2 and Persistence Boundaries
work_items.summary: Bumped schema version to V2 and established clean schema evolution path without legacy backward compatibility baggage.
